levels.title: Beginner
levels.description: Introduce yourself, order food, ask the way and talk about your day — in Spain and Latin America.

levels.title: Elementary
levels.description: Talk about the past, travel, health, home, work and plans; eat out and share memories.

levels.title: Intermediate
levels.description: Give opinions, tell stories, talk about feelings, careers, the news and the environment, imagine what if, and explore festivals.

levels.title: Upper intermediate
levels.description: Argue, negotiate, follow the news and talk about technology, health and city life — with idioms from Spain and Latin America.

levels.title: Advanced
levels.description: Shift register with ease, use discourse markers like a native, persuade, present, handle delicate conversations and tell a story well.

levels.title: Mastery
levels.description: Speak with native-like precision, wit and awareness of the Spanish-speaking world's variety.

tracks.title: Pronunciation
tracks.description: Train the sounds English speakers find hard: pure vowels, tapped r and rolled rr, ñ, ll/y, j/g, b/v, stress and written accents, linking and regional accents. New units unlock as you reach each level.
